minutes.headline: Zoning board approved a two-car garage at 5 Crocker Ave and a third wall sign at the 400 Electric Ave gas station.
minutes.summary: Held remotely by Zoom during COVID-19, the Zoning Board of Appeals heard two special permit petitions. The Boyle garage was approved on condition the building inspector agrees the support structure at the back is adequate. The additional Refuel and Refresh wall sign at the Tasco/Dunkin site was approved, with some members unhappy it was not raised in the original petition.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals approved a special permit to add a two-car garage at 5 Crocker Ave, 4-0, on condition the building inspector agrees the rear support structure is adequate.
The board approved an additional wall sign at 400 Electric Avenue, 4-0, after some members questioned why it was not in the original petition.
Garage applicants were told the written decision will come by mail within 14 days and should be recorded at the registry.
Sign applicants were told of a 20-day appeal period, and the board asked them not to start work until it ends.
No members of the public commented on either petition; the meeting was held remotely by Zoom.

why_it_matters: Special permits for setbacks and signs set what neighbors can see and live next to, and the appeal period is the window in which an abutter can challenge them.
The garage approval depends on a later building inspector sign-off, so the outcome is not final until that check is made.
